print(f"Agent: boundary={agent['boundary']}")

for g in top_greens:
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': sum(rows)//len(rows), 'col': sum(cols)//len(cols)}])

greens_after = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After top row: {len(greens_after)} greens")

# Now for bottom row, move agent to each column before clicking
# Agent moves LEFT/RIGHT in the bottom sky blue region
# The bottom sky blue region is at rows 37-62, cols 18-53 (approximately)

print(f"After click: {len(greens_after2)} greens, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
